items.title: NVIDIA Just Dropped 31% in a Month. Will NVDA Stock Hit $125 or $200 First?
items.summary: A CEO resignation, a credit rating on watch, and export rules scrambling China-bound GPUs have rattled the AI trade's biggest name. Two very different futures now compete for NVIDIA shares, and the next catalysts could tip the balance.

items.title: S&P’s NVIDIA Warning is Backward Looking Governance Theater That Gives Everyone an Opportunity to Buy at $150
items.summary: NVIDIA lost its CEO, drew a credit warning, and watched its stock slide nearly a third in a month. So why does one investor keep buying more every week, and which three numbers convinced him the real story lies elsewhere?

items.title: Marvell Reports Tuesday. How Often Has It Dropped 10%?
items.summary: Marvell Technology reports its quarterly results next Tuesday, Dec 1, after the market close. The first trading session after that report is Wednesday, Dec 2. In the 26 reports our earnings calendar lists since March 2020, Marvell fell 10% or more the next day 6 times. That is about 1 in 4 reports.
